# Mulo AI -- Project Map for AI Agents
# Read this file first before answering any architecture or product question.

## Mission
Help millions of people in the UK make better financial decisions through simple, personalised education.

## Product Model: See -> Learn -> Act
- Layer 1 (SEE): Open Banking financial overview.
- Layer 2 (LEARN): 3-screen micro-lessons, 30-60s each.
- Layer 3 (ACT): Compare products and switch providers. Mulo earns referral commissions.

## Repository Layout

### requirements/ -- Product Specifications
- requirements/content/programmes/ -- Educational programme definitions (PROG-NNN-name.md). Template: templates/template-programme.md. Rule: create-programme.mdc.
- requirements/content/lessons/ -- Individual micro-lesson specs (LESSON-NNN-name.md). Template: templates/template-lesson.md. Rule: create-lesson.mdc.
- requirements/app/features/ -- App UX/UI feature specs (FEAT-NNN-name.md). Template: templates/template-feature.md. Rule: create-feature.mdc.
- requirements/app/agents/ -- AI agent specifications (AGENT-NNN-name.md). Template: templates/template-agent.md. Rule: create-agent.mdc.

### knowledge/ -- Fact Base (manually curated)
- knowledge/personas.md -- Five target personas: Sarah, James, Aisha, Tom, Chloe.
- knowledge/fca-regulations.md -- FCA Consumer Duty compliance boundaries.
- knowledge/glossary.md -- Domain-specific terminology.
- knowledge/market-context.md -- UK financial education market landscape.
- knowledge/llms.txt -- This file. Machine-readable project summary.

### docs/ -- Project Documentation
- docs/vision-and-product.md -- Product vision, mission, and 3-layer architecture.

### functions/ -- Backend Engine (PROTECTED, read-only for AI)
- functions/src/ -- Cloud Function execution logic (Maker-Checker loop).
- functions/prompts/ -- Gemini AI agent prompt definitions.
- functions/docs/ -- Agent behavioural rules, compliance documents, design guidelines.

### templates/ -- Document Templates
- templates/template-programme.md -- Programme specification template.
- templates/template-lesson.md -- Micro-lesson specification template.
- templates/template-feature.md -- App feature specification template.
- templates/template-agent.md -- Agent specification template.
- templates/template-atmi.md -- Apply to My Money insight card template.
- templates/template-epic.md -- (Legacy) Epic definition template.
- templates/template-service-blueprint.md -- (Legacy) Service blueprint template.
- templates/template-story.md -- (Legacy) User story template.

### .cursor/rules/ -- AI Instruction Layer
- 01-repo-standards.mdc -- Global standards, GitOps, UK English, europe-west2.
- 02-use-knowledge.mdc -- Knowledge routing, FCA compliance mandate.
- 03-design-system.mdc -- Colours, typography, word limits, Lottie constraints.
- 04-folder-integrity.mdc -- Strict folder structure enforcement.
- create-programme.mdc -- Generate programme specs.
- create-lesson.mdc -- Generate lesson specs.
- create-feature.mdc -- Generate feature specs.
- create-agent.mdc -- Generate agent specs.
- create-api-spec.mdc -- Generate RESTful API specs.

### .github/skills/ -- GitHub Copilot Agent Skills
Each skill mirrors a corresponding .cursor/rules/ file.

## Core Architecture: 9-Agent Maker-Checker Loop
1. Creator Agent drafts content as structured JSON.
2. Compliance Agent validates against FCA rules in a while loop.
3. Only "status": "PASS" allows a Firestore write.
4. Every write includes compliance_audit field with reasoning and timestamp.
5. Failed drafts logged to agent_logs collection.

## Non-Negotiable Constraints
- Deployment region: europe-west2 (London).
- Language: Strict UK English.
- FCA: Never provide regulated financial advice.
- Design: Background #0A0A1A, Primary #3733E5, CTA mint green, DM Sans font.
- Word limits: Headlines 7, Body 25, Feedback 15.
- All generated documents must include an AI Source Prompt block at the top.
